3 September
Cursor Cloud Agents can now run in Vercel Sandbox
Run Cursor Cloud Agents on infrastructure you control with Vercel Sandbox, using scale-to-zero workers, isolated microVMs, and durable orchestration.
Allen Zhou
Member of Technical Staff
Basic build machines are now available on Pro and Enterprise
Pro and Enterprise teams can now select Basic build machines, 2 vCPU and 8 GB, a lower-cost option for smaller apps. New projects still default to Elastic.
Mehul Kar
Software Engineer
2 September
Free domain with Pro offer now includes .app and .dev
The free domain with Pro offer now covers .app and .dev, bringing the eligible TLDs to eight. Every Pro team can claim one domain, free for the first year.
Jeremy Dopkin, Elliot Dauber, and 1 other
Muse Spark 1.3 now available on AI Gateway
Call Meta's Muse Spark 1.3 through Vercel AI Gateway with one API key: no provider account, fallbacks, spend tracking, and traces on every request.
Zachary Chen, Jerilyn Zheng
